_provenance.source: Unpublished research brief (not included in this repository), 'Phrases and patterns that work' table plus Stages 2-6 of its Recommendations.
_provenance.register: Warm but restrained, decided at intake 2026-08-26. Sincere, specific, process-focused. Severity escalates the AMOUNT OF SCAFFOLDING, never the amount of enthusiasm.
_provenance.specificity: Templates must name the actual file or error signature. The brief is explicit that specific beats global; a template that only says 'this' is a template bug.
_provenance.autonomy_scope: Approach only. No template may offer a choice about whether to continue the work.
_provenance.repetition: The full {what} string is emitted at most ONCE per intervention; later slots use {what_short}. Repeating the same specific phrase three times reads as generated text. That this undercuts sincerity is this project's inference; that praise helps only when it reads as sincere is Henderlong & Lepper 2002.

validate.source: Stage 2 / Key Finding 1 — validate before you problem-solve (Linehan; Shenk & Fruzzetti 2011). Normalise the struggle without minimising or catastrophising it.
templates: This one is genuinely hard. {n_fail} attempts against the same failure is a normal shape for a problem like this.
Being stuck here is a reasonable place to be — {what} is behaving in a way the obvious reading does not predict.

relabel.source: Abramson, Seligman & Teasdale 1978 — recast the cause as specific, temporary and controllable rather than internal, stable and global. Dweck's 'yet' framing.
templates: What is stuck is specific: {what}. That is one step, not the design, and it has not been cracked yet.
The block is {what} — narrow, and not yet solved. That is a fact about the attempts so far, not about the ceiling.

progress.source: Amabile & Kramer 2011 — the progress principle: small wins on meaningful work are the strongest daily driver of motivation.
templates: For context: {n_ok} of the last {n_tools} steps in this window landed cleanly, so the failure is isolated to {what}.
The surface has narrowed — {n_ok} of {n_tools} recent steps came back clean, leaving {what}.

decompose.source: Bandura & Schunk 1981 — proximal subgoals beat distal goals on self-efficacy and skill. 'What is the very next step' is the mechanism, not a nicety.

autonomy.source: Deci & Ryan SDT; Reeve & Cheon 2021 — non-pressuring language and genuine choice sustain intrinsic motivation. Scope limited to approach by decision at the F3 plan gate.
templates: You could {move_a}, or {move_b} — either is a reasonable route.
autonomy._note: move_a and move_b are allocated distinctly from the move decompose already stated, and if_then gets move_c. No slot ever restates another slot's step.

if_then.source: Gollwitzer implementation intentions; Oettingen mental contrasting (WOOP) — pre-commit a concrete response to the named obstacle.
templates: If the next run shows the same failure again, then {move_c}, rather than repeating the last change.

stand_down.source: Recommendations, Thresholds that change the plan — do not encourage sunk-cost persistence on an unachievable goal. Deliberately contains no encouragement vocabulary and no 'yet'.
templates: The environment is blocking this, not the approach: {what}, {n_fail} times. More attempts will not change that. State what would be needed, or take the route that does not require it.

moves._note: Each crossed signal maps to a concrete next action. Deterministic: the move is chosen by which signal crossed, never invented.
moves.repeated_error_count: print the actual value the assertion is comparing before the next edit, so the next change is driven by data rather than a guess
moves.current_error_run: reproduce the failure in isolation, outside the full run, so the loop gets shorter
moves.edit_thrash: stop editing {file} and read the failure end to end once — {n_edits} edits have not changed the shape of the error
moves.command_repeat: change the command rather than the code — the same invocation has run {n_cmd} times for the same result
moves.reread_thrash: write down what is already known about {file} instead of reading it again
moves.calls_since_success: shrink the target: get one smaller assertion passing before the full case
moves.consecutive_tool_errors: take the last error literally and address only what it names, nothing else
moves.env_blocked_errors: name the missing dependency and pick the path that does not need it

fallback_moves._note: Used when the crossed signals yield fewer concrete moves than the emitted slots need. Generic but real, and never a repeat of a move already stated.
moves: reproduce the failure in isolation, outside the full run
state the smallest assertion that should pass and target only that
re-read the failure output end to end before making another change
